review_scope: Coordinates used to sample CAMS for the 27 supplied PM2.5 station series

sources.name: BMKG AWS Center station marker service
sources.use: Official marker verification for seven locations missing from the existing AQ operational registry

sources.name: BMKG West Kalimantan UPT profile
sources.use: Authoritative Mempawah station address and coordinate at Jongkat

sources.name: Jurnal Sains & Teknologi Modifikasi Cuaca 25(1), 2024
sources.use: Independent published confirmation that the Jongkat site contains the hourly BAM PM2.5 instrument

material_correction.reason: The supplied Mempawah PM2.5 series represents the Stasiun Klimatologi Kalimantan Barat BAM at Jongkat. The legacy longitude was inconsistent with official BMKG location evidence by more than one degree.

interpretation: Other legacy coordinates are retained for this experiment unless an official source demonstrated a material site mismatch. Several differ slightly from current AWS marker positions; such differences are below the 0.4-degree CAMS grid spacing but remain a metadata-maintenance item.
